question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Acknowlege"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Acknowledge"**. (स्वीकार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He refused to acknowledge his mistake.
 
 
 
• **"Acknowledge"** means to accept or admit the existence or truth of something. (स्वीकार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She acknowledged the help she received from her friends.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Territory** (क्षेत्र): An area of land under the jurisdiction of a ruler or state.
 
 
• **Example:** The country expanded its territory after the war.
 
 
 
• **Excellence** (श्रेष्ठता): The quality of being outstanding or extremely good.
 
 
• **Example:** She received an award for academic excellence.
 
 
 
• **Business** (व्यवसाय): The practice of making one's living by engaging in commerce.
 
 
• **Example:** He started a new business in the city.
